layout_layer.rule: mega-run rule 4b (coordinator decision 03:47): generated linker order is admissible as a separately labeled layout layer; precedent Fees #392 and Codex's qualified Mayhem builds
layout_layer.source: mega-run lane mg-A-raw (WIN-01 on union-755, regenerated here for this tree)
layout_layer.procedure: pass 1: tools/lbuild-raw.sh builds the root crate with `cargo rustc ... -- -C linker=lwrap-lin.sh` (byte-identical to the source-only build; the wrapper saves the link inputs and map); tools/lay.py binds candidate functions/data atoms to original windows/addresses and writes layout/ordered.ld (--mode order: .text input sections in original window order, .rodata/.data.rel.ro atoms in bound original-address order, no padding, no address assignments); pass 2 relinks with ordered.ld
